notes.title: 🎮 Claw & Load Demo – New Update Is Ready!
notes.notes:
Hey Miners and Meowling Commanders!

The Claw & Load demo is getting an update! We've fixed bugs, added fresh content, and made improvements across the board — from smoother controls and better maps to a new boss, UI tweaks, and even a long-awaited tutorial and challenge mode.

✅ What's New in This Update[olist]      Character Control Improvements          Increased base movement speed and acceleration      Added new movement-speed-related upgrade options      Buffed existing movement-related upgrades            Magnet Item Rework          Removed the need for external upgrades to collect minerals      Now collects both minerals and XP by default            Machine Gun Upgrade Path          Added global damage boost against enemies for all weapons            Cat Archer Buffs          Increased damage on E and Q skills            Map & Resource Adjustments          Tweaked the number and placement of explosive blocks in early and snowy areas      Improved terrain between snowy area and treehole maze      Increased spawn points and frequency of blue mineral vendors and iron balls      Increased mineral drop rate in the cellar area      Adjusted meowshroom spawn zones and quantity            Game Pace Tweaks          Delayed the "Dark Night" event in the snowy area from 25 to 30 minutes            New Gameplay Content          Added post-clear Challenge Mode      Introduced a new boss in the Demonic Portal Zone            Poison Pool Changes          Changed to low HP drain + heavy slow      Visual guidance and warnings to be improved in future            New Player Tutorial          Added a short onboarding tutorial for new players            UI & Text Fixes          Fixed sound effect overlay issues during firing      Fixed upgrade UI error when dying during level-up      Fixed Traditional Chinese text clipping            Death Altar Guidance          Added directional hints after boss death            Orange Relic Adjustments          Added multiple new orange relic effects      Fixed bug where single-limit relics could appear multiple times            Visual Effects          Reduced brightness of certain skill effects      [/olist]
The updated demo will be live very soon — we’d love for you to give it a try!
Feel free to share your thoughts or report bugs in our Discord server.  We’re actively improving the game and working toward a stronger, fuller release!
